events.label: Marco Rubio comments on Guilfoyle allegations

slots.name: condemnation response
slots.sentence: Vice President JD Vance and Secretary of State Marco Rubio on Thursday declined to condemn U.S. Ambassador to Greece Kimberly Guilfoyle over allegations that she asked a Trump donor to pay her $100,000 credit card bill as she was preparing for her confirmation hearing before the Senate.
